{"say":"A voice kit for Skerrow: oaths by the Tidemother and the Old Stars, rooted in sea, salt and tar, with three groups (fisherfolk of the Hythe, the lamp and the learned, the witch of the Heights). The fisherfolk are the default. Time goes by tides and bells, distance by oar-strokes and shouts. I kept to the names in the world text; the group split is my guess, so reshape it if you had other lines in mind.","yaml":"voice:
  oaths:
    tidemother:
      - "Tidemother take me"
      - "By the ebb and the flood"
      - "Salt in my mouth if I lie"
    old_stars:
      - "By the Old Stars"
      - "Stars keep us"
      - "As the Old Stars saw it"
  sayings:
    - "The sea gives, and the Tidemother keeps the tally."
    - "Tar the seam before the storm, not after."
    - "A dark lamp is an open grave."
    - "Every tide goes out, and every tide comes back."
  groups:
    - id: hythe_folk
      name: the fisherfolk of the Hythe
      areas: [skerrow_hythe, skerrow_shore, skerrow]
      professions: [fisher, boatman, innkeeper, child]
      oaths:
        - "Tar and tide"
        - "Pitch and brine"
        - "Rot my nets"
      sayings:
        - "Tar on the hands, bread on the board."
        - "Never count the catch till the boat's drawn up."
        - "A slack line tells no lies."
    - id: lamp_folk
      name: the keepers and the learned
      areas: [skerrow_hythe, skerrow_heights]
      professions: [lightkeeper, scholar, steward]
      oaths:
        - "Oil and wick"
        - "By the Lamp of Skerrow"
      sayings:
        - "Trim the wick and trust the dark to no one."
        - "What Aldmar wrote, the sea still reads."
    - id: heights_folk
      name: the witch of the Heights
      areas: [skerrow_heights]
      professions: [hedge_witch]
      oaths:
        - "Wind and bone"
        - "By the barrow's breath"
      sayings:
        - "Let sleeping wyrms lie, and let old Skarth dream."
        - "Salt keeps the door, and a rune keeps the salt."
  default_group: hythe_folk
  address:
    stranger: ["stranger", "castaway", "you off the Grey Gull"]
    known: ["neighbour", "shipmate"]
    friend: ["old salt", "my heart", "lass/lad/mate"]
    high: ["master/mistress", "steward", "keeper"]
  time:
    - "on the ebb"
    - "at the turn of the tide"
    - "by the second bell"
    - "two tides from now"
    - "at lamp-lighting"
    - "before the winter storms"
  distance:
    - "a shout off"
    - "a hundred oar-strokes"
    - "half a tide's walk"
    - "out past the skerries"
  measures:
    - "a creel of fish"
    - "a fathom of line"
    - "a pot of tar"
    - "a cask of lamp oil"
    - "a handful of salt"
  not_here:
    - word: hour
      instead: bell
    - word: minute
      instead: a breath or two
    - word: week
      instead: a run of tides
    - word: Monday
      instead: first bell-day
    - word: Sunday
      instead: Tide-day
    - word: January
      instead: the Deep Dark
    - word: December
      instead: Storm-month
    - word: okay
      instead: aye, well enough
    - word: dollar
      instead: silver piece"}
